correctness.rationale: The Desargues graph is the bipartite double of Petersen: ten left two-subsets, ten right, adjacent when disjoint. Every perfect matching is an admissible 10x10 bijection. Independent backtracking counted 60. Contract a fixed matching; each remaining edge is one directed arc in a ten-vertex, twenty-arc loopless digraph; alternating cycles correspond to directed cycles. A minimum deletion set hitting all such cycles equals minimum feedback arc set = 20−max over linear vertex orders of forward arcs. Exact subset recurrence over all 2^10 vertex sets computed, independently of the packaged verifier, giving 6 matchings with anti-forcing 5 and 54 with anti-forcing 6. The supplied 240-action orbit/transversal verifier source was independently read; its exhaustive definitions support exceptional size-6 involutive Petersen lifts and other orbit sizes 24,30. Finite exhaustive enumeration is a complete proof for this fixed graph, not extrapolation.
